violet: Hey team  first day, hi! M2 MacBook, using zsh. I cloned ~/dotfiles and ran the installer but `which node` -> /usr/bin/node and asdf shows nodejs 18.16.0 installed. asdf shims are at ~/.asdf/shims but not in front. Any zsh-specific gotchas? Also where should I stash REDWOOD_API_KEY locally for quick experiments?
anna: welcome violet! :tada: Quick checklist: 1) put PATH changes in ~/.zprofile (login shells) not ~/.zshrc; prepend shims: `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` then `eval "$(asdf init zsh)"`. 2) `asdf reshim nodejs` after install. 3) run `hash -r` to clear zsh command cache.
violet: moved init to ~/.zprofile and reshimmed  node now shows v18.16.0. thanks. about REDWOOD_API_KEY: is that in 1Password or do people put it in .envrc?
mike: secrets live in 1Password. We name personal dev keys `redwood-personal-<name>`. For local dev use direnv: add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` to a local .envrc and `direnv allow`. Never commit keys. If you need a new test key ping #support.
violet: installing gpg commit key and hit pinentry error (pinentry-curses). quick mac fix?
anna: `brew install pinentry-mac` then in ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf set `pinentry-program /opt/homebrew/bin/pinentry-mac` and add `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` to ~/.zprofile. Restart agent: `gpgconf --kill gpg-agent && gpgconf --launch gpg-agent`.
violet: that fixed it. last odd thing: VSCode integrated terminal didn't pick up direnv env so tests failed with missing key.
anna: set VSCode to use login shell (terminal.integrated.shellArgs.osx = ["-l"]) or enable terminal.integrated.inheritEnv, or run tests from an external terminal. Also ensure direnv is loaded in your shell init.
devex-bot: (bot) Hi violet! If you'd like pairing, reply "pair" and I'll DM DevEx availability. Onboarding checklist: https://handbook.redwood.dev/onboarding/dev-setup.
violet: all green now  node, gpg, direnv, editor envs. booking a pairing slot to review CI creds later, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
